method.fitness: mean over partition replicates of the group-centered deepest endpoint F1-minus-F0 margin; no semantic input; ties broken by ascending global user index
method.selection: top half (literary), bottom half (anti), deterministic random half (random)
method.stage_diagnostics: margin_by_stage / stage0 / deepest / max / argmax / reversal_gain recorded for every jury run; selection uses deepest margin only
